3615.title: Account selection ignores observed overage
3615.rootCauseOneLine: Quota-only eligibility and affinity retain the overage account despite available scoped quota elsewhere.
3615.proposedFix: Define per-family entitlement evidence and fallback policy before changing account selection.
3615.caveats: Routing reproduced twice; real billing and plan entitlement unverified. No simple fix because product policy and family-specific state need design.
